hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnInNormal".
If the enemy is ready to act and the count "turnInNormal" is at least the numeric entry "turn_num_for_transit_standby_from_normal" in aiArg, then choose state 22 next and stop.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "max_hp_rate_for_transit_defense_once" in aiArg and not the register's 'isTransitDefenseForReminingHpRate', then
  Set the register's 'isTransitDefenseForReminingHpRate' to true.
  Choose state 25 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "max_hp_rate_for_transit_defense" in aiArg and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "prob_for_transit_defense_from_normal" in aiArg, then choose state 25 next and stop.
  If util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "prob_for_transit_standby_from_normal" in aiArg, then choose state 22 next and stop.
  The enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability.

hooks.logic:
Let v be the script register, then the id of the move labelled "tsunami" on the enemy.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnInStandby".
If the count check passes, then
  If the main move id of the last move of the enemy is v, then choose state 24 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the count "turnInStandby" is less than the numeric entry "turn_num_for_tsunami" in aiArg, then the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability.
  Otherwise
    Let v2 be call helper2 with (this state, "ability_tag_stamp_for_tsunami").
    Let data2 be {abilityTag: v2, abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}.
    Let data3 be {abilityTag: "tsunami"}.
    Let v3 be if v2 then [data2, data3] else [data3].
    The enemy uses v with its cast time and then v3.
